title: Look Back, Think Ahead: Visual Memory on Demand for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: Processing long visual token sequences from high-resolution images makes multi-step reasoning computationally expensive for multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing one-shot pruning and aggregation methods compress visual tokens into a fixed context before decoding. However, visual evidence needs can shift as reasoning unfolds, making it difficult for a fixed compressed context to retain all the details needed across stages. To address this challenge, we propose ViMoD, a lightweight framework that maintains a compact visual context while preserving access to original fine-grained evidence as reasoning needs evolve. Deformable Aggregation of Region-wise Tokens (DART) learns content-adaptive groups and aggregation capacities, constructing compact Coarse representations linked to recoverable original Fine tokens. Temporal Routing for Adaptive Contextual Evidence (TRACE) integrates decoding history to anticipate upcoming evidence needs and select, retain, or replace active Fine-token groups. Selected Fine tokens augment the persistent Coarse context in the frozen backbone, enabling stage-specific evidence access without continuously attending to all visual tokens. On Qwen3-VL-4B, ViMoD outperforms all evaluated baselines on all eight reasoning benchmarks at a 20% target visual token budget, improving the mean normalized score by 39.0% over the strongest evaluated one-shot baseline. These gains are achieved with only 0.0546% additional trainable parameters relative to the frozen backbone.

analysis.ideaZh: ViMoD 用可回收coarse/fine视觉memory及SSMrouter按reasoningstage换证据，改变一次性tokenpruning的访问方式。作者报告20%平均activebudget保80.33%Full-normalizedreasoning，较DivPrune57.78高；完整FineKV仍存，peakmemory42.67GiB高于Full38.40，且Full非推荐decode仅MMMU30.92，不能说80%显存压缩或普遍加速。
analysis.motivationZh: 长多模态推理在不同阶段需要不同视觉证据，而一次性 token pruning 可能提前丢掉后续步骤需要的细节。论文希望让视觉证据按推理需求被再次访问，同时降低每一步处理的 active visual tokens。
analysis.methodZh: DART学groupcapacity/contentaffinity，用capacity-constrainedhardassignment和Sinkhornsurrogate聚合layerKV，留C2F映射。TRACE融合三层hiddenstates的四timescaleSSM，每16tokens提案groups并HOLD/UPDATE，JointKV把persistentCoarse、activeoriginalFine及texthistory给frozenQwen。DARTCE/KD，TRACEteacherfutureboxesSFT再RLOOcorrectness与successfuloccupancy反馈。完整27页包括方法导数、data/recipe、calibration、FLOPs/time accounting与annotationprompts已读。

analysis.insightZh: 实质是learned可恢复visualmemory和history-conditionedupcoming-evidencerouter，超单VQA微调；但frozenbackbone本身能力没提高，是压缩条件下的accessarchitecture。SSM/Sinkhorn/KD/RLOO皆已有，one-shot比较同时混入新teacher监督，不能把全gain归dynamicaccess。
analysis.evidenceZh: budget是每responseforward平均Coarse+Fine占比，不是peakmemory或每步硬上限。（Sec.4.1, PDF p.6; Appendix C.2-C.3 Eqs.(31)-(35), pp.23-24）；推理仍完整prefill并保存所有Fine，startup/memorytradeoff实际测得。（Sec.4.4/Fig.6, PDF p.9）；learnedmemory和router各有作用，非全归repeatedrecall。（Tables3-4, PDF p.8）；Full参考decode低于modelcard，不可外推推荐sampling效果。（Appendix C.1, PDF p.23）
analysis.caveatZh: Sec.5 p.9明确initialization/fullFineCoarsestorage增加，shortresponse/broadvisualaccess可能无收益。；C2F粗粒度、16tokeninterval、teacherbias可miss或delayevidence。；跨backbone/alternativegenerationconfig未验证；p23主动披露Fullbaselinegap。；calibrationsamples与specifictolerance未充分公开，averagebudget闭环非monotonic亦可能变。；任务监督比trainingfreepruning更多，效率与能力需分别看。；sameFullnonrecommendeddecode可能夸大长重复导致的one-shottotalcost，推荐config结论unknown。；存全部KV不是memorycompression，更适用于长期图表reasoning而非多用户serving显存优化。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 改变MLLMvisualreasoning过程中证据access与memoryarchitecture，图形/OCR细节可能迁移设计inspection；无直接design/CAD实测，mediumskim，非普通serving优化。
